measurementCondition: Valid 60-second aggregate /proc/stat sample (idle-delta method); all 4 cores online at 1800 MHz, governor=performance; idle/light-load shortly after boot, no active client traffic. Not a controlled multi-client or steering-load test.
notes: Only aggregate CPU utilization was measured (2.47% averaged over a valid 60-second window, load average 0.35/0.47/0.26); no per-process CPU time or percentage breakdown was captured in this pass. This is an idle/light-load result and does not demonstrate sustained forwarding, steering, or multi-client performance. See Hardware Compatibility Specification Section 5.1.2; per-process CPU profiling and loaded-workload testing remain open items (Section 7).
